newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Senior Kuwait ruling family member dies.
newsitem.headline: Senior Kuwait ruling family member dies.

text.p: A senior member of Kuwait's ruling al-Sabah family, Sheikh Ali Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah, has died in London, officials said on Sunday.
Sheikh Ali was born in 1948 and served as interior minister in the last cabinet which resigned in October following general elections. He was defence minister in the previous government.
He is a son to Kuwait's late emir Sheikh Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah who ruled the oil-rich Gulf Arab state from 1965-1977.
Sheikh Ali graduated from Britain's Sandhurst military academy in 1970 and served as an officer in the Kuwaiti military until 1978.
